question: Gangubai Hangal and Prabha Atre were exponents of the ________ Gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gangubai Hangal and Prabha Atre** were exponents of the **Kirana Gharana.**

 
 
• The Kirana Gharana is known for its focus on perfect intonation and the intricate use of microtones (shrutis).
 
• Gangubai Hangal was an Indian classical singer of the khyal genre of Hindustani classical music.
 
• Prabha Atre is also a renowned Indian classical vocalist from the same Gharana, known for her innovative approach and contributions to classical music.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Gharanas**

 
 
• **Rampur Gharana** is known for its mix of Dhrupad and Khayal styles.
 
• **Jaipur Gharana** is recognized for its intricate and complex singing style.
 
• The **Mewati gharana** is a Hindustani classical music apprenticeship tribe that was founded in the late 19th century by brothers Ghagge Nazir Khan and Wahid Khan of Indore.
 
 
• Key Exponents - Pandit Jasraj, Ustad Rais Khan, Mohd Shafi etc.
